title: Bustier Skirt Look, Embellished
concept: A sculpted silhouette balancing softness, restraint, and ornamental detail.
description: This look is an original design developed for the Terra 360 collection, built around the contrast between structured form and softened volume. The outfit combines a crisp cotton poplin shirt with a high bustier skirt in dark burgundy faux leather, cut close through the waist and upper body before opening into a wider skirt silhouette. Long glossy gloves extend the vertical line of the look, while an embellished cotton tie introduces a decorative focal point through embroidered and jewel-like detailing.

construction.fit: The shirt has a softly rounded fit, creating light volume through the upper body. The bustier skirt is fitted through the waist and upper torso, then opens into a wider, semi-flared shape.
construction.collar: Classic small shirt collar, close to a French collar proportion. The neckline is completed with a cotton tie placed as a central decorative element.
construction.seams: The skirt is structured through vertical panel seams that define and support the silhouette. Stitching remains subtle and clean across the shirt and accessories.
construction.fabric: The look combines crisp cotton poplin, glossy dark burgundy faux leather, and a cotton tie embellished with decorative detailing. The contrast between matte and reflective surfaces adds depth to the outfit.
construction.volume: Volume is restrained in the lower structured section and softer in the upper shirt. The silhouette expands gradually from the fitted bustier into a controlled, wider skirt.
